errors.evidence: The description omits the presence of the legend in the bottom-right corner, which is the key element that maps the line colors to their respective metrics (Precision, Recall, F1-score).

errors.text_span: and decreases to around 77% at 7.0B, with a relatively steady trend
errors.evidence: The red line (Precision) does not have a steady trend. It first decreases from approximately 78% to a minimum of about 70% at the 410m model size, and then it increases again to about 77% at 7.0B. Describing this as a steady trend is a significant oversimplification that misses a key feature of the data.
The blue line (Recall) starts at a value closer to 8% for the 70m model size, not 10%. The data point is visibly below the halfway mark between 0% and 20%.
The description fails to mention that all data points on the lines are indicated by triangle-shaped markers.
